_comment: FICTIONAL sample terminal payload, shipped so every step after the call runs with no credentials and no real call. The organization and the +1 555 0100 number are reserved fictional examples. It deliberately shows the shape a usable call has: the respondent confirms the practice by name BEFORE any question, and the agent asks one question at a time. A call missing either of those abstains, which is the point.
